items.text: Added modern sprint movement with in‑game settings that persist for non‑admin players.
Scientists now use replay‑based aiming, matching real‑player accuracy, with corrected aim after crouch‑hovering and proper door‑search logic.
Fixed scientist rotation bugs that caused upside‑down poses and unresponsive behavior, including issues with mounted scientists and seat aim limits.
Renaming livestock no longer requires a delay.
Sprinklers no longer wet players through floors or ceilings, and fishing villages now spawn at appropriate distances from river mouths.
Deployables placed next to a split‑off part stay with the correct building after a split, and sleeping bags can be placed adjacent without respawn‑space checks, preventing them from getting stuck.
Dog commands were improved: a better heel command and dogs now move at player speed, enhancing control and realism.
Added the M939 Truck to the Excavator Monument, giving players a new vehicle option.
Car repel force now works correctly when the repelling point is exactly on an animal.
Freight lift prototype added to the exit test scene, allowing an entire team to extract together.

Extraction UI refined: shared look‑check for escape hatch and balloon‑pad console, unified tracker for panel options, and hold bars now show a large label with whole‑number percentage and thick orange bar.
Items stored in backpacks now correctly count toward mission progress.
StaticMissionItemDispenser tracking fixed, ensuring objectives are recorded properly.
Dropping items on thin surfaces (e.g., oil‑rig floors) no longer gets blocked by line‑of‑sight checks.
RakNet connection slots now scale with server.maxplayers instead of a fixed 1024 limit.
Fixed a long‑standing overlap bug so trees, ore nodes, junkpiles and other world objects no longer intersect, improving resource placement and preventing clipping issues.
Adjusted cave generation to ensure caves never overlap underground tunnel bunker entrances, keeping monument entrances clear and usable.
Mission item dispensers now work reliably, guaranteeing that mission rewards are correctly delivered to players.
Fixed a bug that could block items from dropping, ensuring loot spawns as expected when containers are broken or players die.
Mounted gun aiming lag has been removed, making gun pitch response immediate and improving combat accuracy.
Applied a chassis prefab fix that resolves vehicle chassis issues, improving vehicle stability and handling.
Mortar aiming now aligns correctly with player pitch, eliminating hand lag.
New livestock animals added, expanding farming options and resource yields.
Additional livestock animals added, further diversifying animal farming.
M939 Truck now spawns at Mining Quarry monuments, providing new transport for quarry operations.
M939 Truck now available at Gas Station monuments, increasing vehicle access in that area.
Sprinkler wet floor behavior fixed, preventing unintended slipping on wet surfaces.

items.text: Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.
Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.

Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.
Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.

Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.
Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.
Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.

2026-11-22.summary:
### Map Layout
- Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
- The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.

### AI & Reinforcements
- Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.
- Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.

### Economy & Pricing
- Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.
- Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.

### Inventory & Loot
- Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
- Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

### Raid & Extraction
- Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
- Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
- Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
- Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.

Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.

Raid maps now spawn only whitelisted monuments, with each tier‑1 monument appearing once per map.
Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.
